title: Per-app extraction recipe (one file of corpus/extraction-recipes/)
description: A document-derived route map for an authorized tenant teardown. A recipe is a hypothesis until verified: doc-derived-unverified recipes must be checked against current documentation, entitlements, region, and the live tenant before their claims enter an evidence base. The v0.7 sources array is a recipe-level bibliography, not machine-enforced claim-to-source lineage.

app.description: kebab-case slug, matches the filename and the apps.json entry

category.description: kebab-case category, e.g. crm, erp-finance, hr-payroll, itsm

summary.description: what the customer is entitled to export, in one or two sentences, per the vendor's own terms or docs

tos_url.description: URL of the terms/DPA/export-policy page consulted

post_termination_window.description: documented data-retrieval window after termination (e.g. '30 days'), null if not documented

routes.description: extraction routes in descending preference order

route_type.description: account-export: whole-tenant/backup export. entity-export: per-entity CSV/XLSX from the UI. config-export: metadata/customization artifacts (SDF, Metadata API packages)

covers.description: entities or artifact kinds this route extracts, e.g. contacts, invoices, attachments, audit-log, workflow-definitions

how.description: concrete steps or endpoint, compressed: nav path for UI routes, endpoint + auth style for APIs

requires.description: role, plan/SKU, API token type, or vendor ticket this route needs

gotchas.description: field truncation, attachments not included, pagination caps, silent export failures

preservation_notes.description: the Phase 4b checklist items that need app-specific answers; null means the docs don't say — verify in-tenant

attachments.description: how files/attachments/documents are bulk-extracted, or null if undocumented

audit_log.description: how the audit/activity log is exported and its documented retention

config_artifacts.description: how customizations (fields, workflows, reports) export as restorable artifacts

sources.description: Recipe-level bibliography. Presence proves neither source availability nor claim support; reviewers must verify both.

verification.description: doc-derived-unverified: researched from vendor docs, never exercised. community-verified: a shared teardown confirmed the main routes. tenant-verified: exercised end-to-end in a real teardown. Only promote with evidence.

notes.description: anything that fits nowhere above; honest unknowns belong here. Describe the product and the documents, not the research session: constraints of the pass that produced the recipe go in research_caveats

research_caveats.description: Constraints of the research pass that produced this recipe: vendor hosts that could not be fetched, exhausted search budgets, mirrors or source repositories read instead of live vendor pages, and which claims therefore rest on search-engine excerpts. These describe how the documents were consulted, not what they say. They are part of the recipe's provenance and must be preserved when a recipe is revised; they are removed only when a later pass consults the affected sources directly
